messages.subject: Countour for a map missing
parts:
Hi, I want to get a map countour ( I have already the polygon shapefile of my area (border.shp)
I don't know how to add this border to my plot. This my code (I get one part from Stackoverflow)


require("ggplot2")
require("plyr")
require("rgeos")
data <- "test.txt"
gauges <- read.csv(data, col.names=c("gauge_id","precip","x","y"),header=T,sep="\t");
cnames <- aggregate(cbind(x, y) ~ gauge_id, data=gauges, FUN=mean)
#x and y  are respectively longitude and latitude
ggplot(gauges, aes(x, y)) + 
  geom_polygon(aes(fill=precip,group=gauge_id), colour='black', fill=NA) +
  geom_text(data=cnames, aes(x, y, label = gauge_id), size=2.5)+ coord_map()

border= readOGR(dsn=".", layer="border")
plot(border,add=TRUE) # I get nothing


Thank's in advance.
